techStack: `verbatimModuleSyntax: true` — type-only imports must use `import type`
Vitest v4 with globals (describe/it/expect available without imports), Supertest for HTTP integration tests
Test setup stubs global fetch before each test — real network calls never happen
features: Currently parsed query params: `search`, `category`, `inStock`, `sort` (price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc), `page`, `limit`
`featured` param has a TODO comment in queryParser.ts line 23 — not parsed yet
`rating_desc` has TODO comments in queryParser.ts line 4 and productService.ts line 34 — not in VALID_SORT_OPTIONS and no sort branch
No product in products.ts has a `featured` field set (all 15 products lack the field entirely)
Failing test suites: 'Featured filter' (3 tests) and 'Rating sort' (1 test)
architecture: Layer order: app.ts → routes/productRoutes.ts → controllers/productController.ts → services/productService.ts → services/dataFetcher.ts
Types centralised in src/types/product.ts — `SortOption` already includes `'rating_desc'`, `Product` already has `featured?: boolean`; no type changes needed
queryParser.ts is the sole place that converts raw req.query strings to typed ProductQuery; service never reads req.query
productService.ts applies all business logic: filters (search → category → inStock → [featured]) → sort → paginate
VALID_SORT_OPTIONS whitelist in queryParser.ts gates which sort values reach the service; adding a sort requires updating it there first
New `featured` filter must slot after inStock filter and before the sort block, applied to `result` (already filtered), not the original array
Sort branches use `[...result].sort(...)` spread — existing pattern to follow for rating_desc
edgeCases: `p.featured ?? false` is required (not `p.featured === false`) — 11 non-featured products have `featured: undefined`; strict false-check would return 0 for featured=false query
`rating_desc` sort must spread before sorting (`[...result].sort(...)`) to avoid mutating the in-scope array
Featured filter must operate on `result` (not the original products array) so it intersects correctly with all prior filters (search, category, inStock)
`featured` filter must be placed before `total = result.length` to ensure the pagination envelope reflects the filtered count
Parser must map string `'true'` → `true` and `'false'` → `false`; any other value (absent, empty, arbitrary string) must leave `query.featured` undefined so no filter is applied
`rating_desc` must be added to VALID_SORT_OPTIONS before the service branch is reachable — without it the parser silently drops the param and the sort is a no-op
